cart.item: Noisewave N2 Wireless Earbuds with ANC (Charcoal)

concerns.what: Extended warranty add-on (+₹299/item) was offered by default with an 'Add protection' button alongside 'No, thanks' — I selected 'No, thanks' to keep things basic as requested.

'Order Protection' (+₹49) was pre-checked by default ('Included on this order — untick if you don't want it'), with a nudge message that 'most customers end up keeping it on'. This wasn't requested and isn't needed for a basic order, so I unticked it.
Cartwheel Plus membership (₹999/year, auto-renewing) was offered as an add-on to the order. Not requested, so I declined via 'No, thanks'.
'Send me offers and updates by email' marketing checkbox was present but unchecked by default — left unchecked since it wasn't requested.
Colour defaulted to Charcoal; no colour preference was specified by the user.

askUser: The earbuds come in Charcoal, Ivory, or Teal — I kept the default Charcoal. Would you prefer a different colour for your brother?
